faqs.q: Can an AI agent reply in Slack threads?
faqs.a: Yes. It replies under the message with “Send Message as Thread”, or posts to the channel or a person with “Send Message”. Say which you want in the ask, for example “reply in the thread”.

faqs.q: How is this different from Slackbot or Slack's own AI?
faqs.a: Slack's built-in AI works on the messages inside Slack and comes with its paid plans. 50agents treats Slack as one of your apps, so the work can start in Stripe, Calendly, Gmail or a form and finish in your channel, with steps across tools.

faqs.q: Does a post to a channel wait for my approval?
faqs.a: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits in Needs you until you approve it, and an AI agent asks before sending until you allow it in Settings. You decide when it may post on its own.

faqs.q: Can it post in a private channel?
faqs.a: Yes, with “Message Private Channel”. Slack only lets an app see private channels it has been invited to, so add the app to the channel first.

faqs.q: Does a new Slack message start the work at once?
faqs.a: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” and “New Thread Message Instant” fire as messages arrive. “New Message in Channels”, “New Mention” and the other message triggers are checked on a schedule, so they run a little later.

faqs.q: Can it ask the team to approve something?
faqs.a: Yes. “Send Interactive Message” posts buttons or a form, so people answer in Slack instead of opening another app, and the next step waits for the answer.

faqs.q: Do I need to write code or build a flowchart?
faqs.a: No. You write the job in a sentence, Captain shows the plan in plain words, and you change any step by saying so.
Every workspace starts free with 2,000 credits a month, which covers building your first jobs and running them. The plans are on the pricing page.
